title: Task-collision rule (not archived + same project + case-insensitive name match) is re-encoded at seven sites across two f
description: The predicate deciding whether a task name collides — not archived, same project, case-insensitive name equality — is written out separately at seven places across src-tauri/src/lib.rs (2776, 2978, 3900, 5053, 7236) and src-tauri/src/cli_server.rs (967, 2346), most of them added by this PR, including one inside the taken-name closure of the unique-name helper. Three of the sites spell the rule as a wrapped multi-line boolean and vary the receiver, the argument, and which value supplies the project id, so no two are byte-identical. The rule has no single home: a future change to what counts as a collision (say, trimming or Unicode case folding) has to land in all seven at once or they silently disagree. The repository's own reviewer approved the PR but asked for a shared helper on the task list.
